Title: 
Modeling Software Engineer 
 
 Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR! 
 
 KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security.
 
 Why Join Us? 
 Innovative Projects: KBR’s work is at the forefront of engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity solutions.

 Collaborative Environment: Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace.

 Impactful Work: Your contributions will be pivotal in designing and optimizing defense systems that ensure national security and shape the future of space defense.

 
 
 Modeling Software Engineer 
 Position Summary 
 The Modeling Software Engineer develops and maintains databases, models, and analytical tools supporting intelligence assessments of adversary PNT and satellite systems.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design and maintain web-enabled technical databases.
 Develop software tools supporting intelligence analysis and threat characterization.
 Create and maintain digital representations of foreign PNT, SATCOM, and navigation architectures.
 Build analytical models, simulations, and mission-support tools.
 Integrate intelligence data from multiple sources into structured repositories.
 Support collection planning and intelligence exploitation activities.
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or related discipline.
 5+ years of software development experience.
 Experience with database design and web technologies.
 Data integration and visualization experience.
 Active TS/SCI Clearence
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Knowledge of GNSS systems and space architectures.
 Experience supporting DoD or IC programs.
 Proficiency with Python, SQL, GIS tools, and data analytics platforms.
 Desired Skills 
 Software Development
 Database Engineering
 Data Modeling
 Analytics
 Intelligence Systems
 
 
 
 
 Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture.  These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company.  That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.
